Hi, I'm Anali.

I studied Banking & Finance and Business Analytics at Monash, and somewhere along the way I noticed the numbers were never the hard part. The hard part was what came after: explaining them to someone who actually had to make a decision. So I came back for a Master of Business Analytics to get better at exactly that.

The more I worked with data, the more I realised the same dataset can mean completely different things depending on who's holding it. A forecast table that makes sense to an economist means nothing to a farmer watching the sky. A climate study written for scientists doesn't help the family deciding whether to stay or leave on a bad fire day. I like figuring out how to close that gap.

That's what this blog is. It started with a question about whether Australia's farm forecasts can be trusted, and led me to the Black Summer bushfires and what climate change is doing to the places we live.

If you're here, chances are you care about this stuff too. I try to keep life fun, but I also think our generation needs to stay informed and face what's actually happening, even when it's uncomfortable.
